Zeitung lesen kannst du in deiner Freizeit.
You can read the newspaper in your free time.

There will never be a perfect protection in a free society, and even if it sounds terrible: Our freedom means that we have to live with many risks.
Freiheit.et: From Middle High German vrīheit, from Old High German frīheit. Equivalent to frei (“free”) + heit (“-hood”). Compare Silesian Freiheet, Paderbornisch Low German Fryheit, Dutch vrijheid

s: freedom fighter (male or of unspecified gender)

freilich.et: From Middle High German vrīlīche(n), from Old High German frīlīhhēn (“freely, without fear or inhibition”). By surface analysis, frei (“free”) + -lich (“-ly”).
